title: SatCompute topology trace manifest 0.2
description: Reproducibility metadata and an authoritative ordered inventory for one deterministic topology trace.

scenario_name.description: Stable scenario name copied from the authoritative scenario input.

scenario_config_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact scenario JSON bytes.

ns3_version.description: Official ns-3 platform baseline used by this trace implementation.

state_semantics.description: Every listed slice is a direct orbit and topology-policy evaluation, independent of live network update cadence.

coordinate_frame.description: Earth-centred, Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinate frame used by node slices.

coordinate_units.description: Position coordinate unit used by node slices.

speed_of_light_m_per_s.description: Propagation constant used to derive distance-mode delays.

simulation_duration_ns.description: Configured positive simulation duration in exact integer nanoseconds.

trace_interval_ns.description: Configured positive output evaluation interval in exact integer nanoseconds.

network_update_interval_ns.description: Independent live-network update interval in exact integer nanoseconds.

include_final_state.description: Whether the trace inventory contains a slice exactly at simulation_duration_ns.

constellation.description: Circular-orbit parameters needed to audit regeneration.

topology.description: Fixed-candidate, distance-gate, delay, and bandwidth parameters used for every slice.

randomness.description: Explicit ns-3 random identity recorded even though the current orbit/topology core consumes no streams.

slice_count.description: Number of ordered entries in slices.

slices.description: Authoritative ordered slice inventory; files not listed here are not part of this trace.

positive_nanoseconds.description: A positive signed 64-bit integer duration in nanoseconds.

name.description: Stable constellation token from the scenario.

pattern.description: RAAN span selected by the scenario.

satellites_per_orbit.description: Stable satellite slots in each plane.

phase_diff.description: Whether odd planes use the legacy alternating half-slot phase offset.

orbit_epoch_offset_ns.description: Physical orbit sampling offset in exact integer nanoseconds.

seam_enabled.description: Whether the final and first orbital planes have inter-plane candidates.

max_isl_distance_m.description: Inclusive active-link distance gate in metres.

fixed_delay_ns.description: Positive fixed-mode delay in nanoseconds, or null in distance mode.

link_bandwidth_bps.description: Full-duplex link bandwidth in bits per second.

randomness.description: Resolved random seed, run, and reserved stream start.

stream_start.description: First deterministic random stream reserved for SatCompute.

slice.description: One paired node/topology output and its integrity hashes.

simulation_time_ns.description: Exact paired slice time in integer nanoseconds.

nodes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact node-slice bytes.

topology_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact topology-slice bytes.

active_link_count.description: Copied active-link count for inventory inspection.
